info.title: VELTRIX API
info.description: Real-time multiplayer Crash game with VIRTUAL points only (VLX). Educational project.

get.summary: The active achievements (safety and learning first) with their XP / VLX reward and how many players unlocked each. Open to guests.

My achievements: unlocked ones with the date, the others with their progress. While I cannot bet (self-excluded,
or today's limit is used up) the ones that ask me to play are left out and playTasksHidden is true.

Who changed what and when, newest first. Filters: action, entityType + entityId
(e.g. User + 5 = everything done to user 5), actorUserId, from/to.
All action names, for the filter drop-down.
Starting balance for new accounts and the daily bonus amount (virtual VLX).

put.summary: Changes take effect immediately (no restart). Each changed value is written to the audit log.

get.summary:
Dashboard header: users, online now, today's rounds/bets/volume (UTC day), VLX in circulation,
and the crash point distribution of the last 1000 rounds next to the share the formula predicts.
One row per day for the charts (from/to as yyyy-MM-dd, UTC; default the last 30 days, max 366).
Users table: search by email or nickname, filter by role and blocked state, paged (newest first).
One user with balance, stats, limits, active sessions, recent transactions and adjustments.

put.summary: Player / Operator / Admin. You cannot change your own role.

Blocks ({"isBlocked": true}) or unblocks a user. Blocking signs the user out on every device
and refuses their bets at once. You cannot block yourself.

post.summary:
Adds (positive amount) or removes (negative amount) virtual VLX with a REQUIRED reason.
The balance can never go negative, and you cannot adjust your own balance.
Creates a Player account with the starting VLX balance and logs in.
Returns a 15-minute access token and a refresh token. 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair. The old refresh token stops working.
Sends a 6-digit one-time reset code (in development it is written to the API log).
Sets a new password using the one-time code. Logs out all sessions.
Places a bet on the current round of a game. Only while betting is open.
Cashes out at the SERVER's current multiplier. The client sends no multiplier or amount.

get.summary: My bet history with date/status filters and paging.
A round's published hash and, once it is over, its seed, crash point and the server's own verification.

post.summary:
Recalculates hash and crash point from a seed. Pass the published hash / crash point to compare.
A logged-in player who verifies a real finished round completes the "Check a round" achievement.

get.summary: Game catalog with search and filters. Open to guests; Disabled games are visible to staff only.

Top players. period: day (last 24 h), week (last 7 days) or all. type: multiplier (best cash-out)
or profit (payouts minus stakes). Open to guests; cached for 10 seconds.
My daily bet limit (and any waiting increase), what I bet today, session reminder, self-exclusion.

put.summary:
Sets the daily bet limit (null = no limit) and the session reminder (0 = off, 15-600 minutes).
A LOWER limit applies at once; a higher limit or removing it applies only after 24 hours.

post.summary:
Pauses betting for Hours24, Days7 or Days30. It can be extended but never shortened or cancelled.
I can still sign in and see my history.

get.summary: My notifications, newest first, with the unread count for the badge. unreadOnly=true hides read ones.

put.summary: Marks all of my notifications as read. Returns how many changed.

get.summary:
A content page, open to guests: "rules" (how Crash works) or "no-winning-strategy".
lang = en (default); a missing translation falls back to English.

post.summary:
The player read this page to its end (the Rules page sends it for "no-winning-strategy"). Reading the rules
completes the learning achievement "Know the rules" once; other pages are only checked to exist.

get.summary: Public player profile: nickname, avatar, member since, level and best results. No private data.
The logged-in user's profile and VLX balance.

put.summary: Changes the nickname (3-20 letters, digits or underscore; must be unique).

get.summary: My UI settings (theme, game sounds, animations). Stored per account, so they follow me to any device.

put.summary: Saves the theme (System / Dark / Light), game sounds and animations (false = reduce motion).
Changes the password. Requires the current password; logs out all other sessions.
put.description:
All refresh tokens are revoked. The access token already in use stays valid until it
expires (max 15 minutes), because JWTs are verified without a DB lookup.

post.summary: Uploads a new avatar (multipart/form-data, field "file"). JPG, PNG or WEBP, max 2 MB.
post.description: Requests over 3 MB are rejected while the form is read, also as 400 ProblemDetails.

File.description: JPG, PNG or WEBP image, max 2 MB.

get.summary: The round being played right now (seed and crash point hidden until it is over).
Finished and cancelled rounds, newest first (use pageSize=20 for the "last 20 crashes" strip).
All bets of a round: who bet how much and when they cashed out.

post.summary: Cancels an unfinished round; every active bet is refunded automatically.
post.description: Not possible once the round has crashed (409).

get.summary:
My statistics: bets, win rate, average cash-out, profit, a daily series for the chart (days = 7-90)
and how my cash-outs are spread over multiplier ranges.
My VLX balance and daily bonus status. Virtual points only, with no monetary value.
My ledger: every balance change with the balance before and after. Filter by type and date.

post.summary: Claims the daily bonus (once every 24 hours).

Bearer.description: Paste the accessToken from /api/auth/login (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
